Team —

Quick runway/coverage sanity pass this morning. Finance flagged a small delta vs. forecast after yesterday's CRM refresh; I want a tight, auditable picture for today’s leadership check-in. Please do the following by EOD today: 

1) Top-of-book confirms (top 10 by expected ARR for your regions) — update Stage, Commit (Yes/No), and Expected Close Date in the attached sheet (Q3_pipe_snapshot_laura_20280804.xlsx).
2) If you’re moving a deal out of Commit or changing dollar value >10%, put a one-line justification in the Notes column and flag me.
3) If finance paperwork or legal redlines are outstanding (contracts, PO, SOC evidence), tag Finance Ops and add the expected clearance date.

Goal: get a clean pipe-to-quota number (and a digestible note per exception) before 4pm PT so we can present a reproducible ledger to Finance and the CRO.

I’ll compile and push a short summary to Neha for 5pm. Thanks.

—Laura

  • RDW-2028-NEON — close date slipped to 2028-09-15; legal ticket LT-457 added.
